text: The request-body landing parses components.requestBodies before main selects supported output types. Each present body must have content/application/json/schema, so an output allowlist does not shield loading from another unsupported body structure. The original also required the section to exist; fixed accepted get_and_parse now defaults a missing section to empty while keeping the present-body parser's strict shape. Schemas and bodies are appended into one map under a comment assuming distinct names, without a collision check in this path. No invalid-input, collision or generation run was performed.
title: Graph output selection happens after strict request-body schema loading
